description: Restaurant search API endpoint for IDOR Eats. Allows searching for restaurants by query string. Accepts GET requests with a 'query' parameter. Returns JSON array of matching restaurants with id, name, address, location coordinates, description, and category.
notes: This API endpoint is public and requires no authentication. Returns restaurant data including IDs which could be used for IDOR attacks on restaurant-specific endpoints. Query parameter may be vulnerable to SQL injection or NoSQL injection.
